display_name: DURA 源扰动响应与波形误差权衡
description: 在每个源组用 24 条记录拟合固定复频域修正，留出 24 条测量波形与四种合成扰动响应。

data.representation: 672 fixed source pilot paired received/clean IQ, frozen DURA output

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

permissions.claim_scope: Held-out source waveform NMSE and artificial perturbation response tradeoff; fitted coefficients not saved or applied on target

checkpoint.initialization: Fixed source-only DURA; diagnostic per-frequency closed-form fit, no network weight updates
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Fixed DURA source-only checkpoint and 672 source L_s/U_s pilot IDs with within-group disjoint fit/holdout
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: DURA source-only with no F/TX/V/target ancestry
checkpoint.selection_rule: Predefined weights 0, 0.05, 0.5 and ridge 0.001, no target selection

expected_artifacts: result.json: 14 held-out source groups, waveform NMSE and four synthetic response metrics

dimensions: RX4/6 and RX8 x seven views x 24
baseline and three fixed source fit weights

rows.method: Complex spectral residual fit with clean waveform plus fixed synthetic response weights
rows.purpose: Test whether source perturbation-response improvements come with held-out waveform damage before designing a network
rows.seed_notes: Fixed deterministic within-group source split and three preregistered response weights
rows.scenario: fixed previously explored source pilot grouped by RX and source simulation view
expected_artifacts: result.json: 14 held-out source groups, waveform NMSE and four synthetic response metrics

notes: Synthetic 1% RMS directions use source clean IQ and estimated DURA action; source diagnosis only.
Waveform and four response terms normalized per source record; direction contributions averaged.
Per-frequency complex coefficients are fit only on half of each source group, evaluated only on held-out records, and never saved.
No F weights, TX labels, V or target reads; DURA may have seen source domain. Not identity performance or deployment evidence.
